classes.label: Disjointness violation
classes.description: An entity belongs to classes declared disjoint.

classes.label: Functional-property conflict
classes.description: A functional property has multiple fillers that are explicitly distinct.

classes.label: Domain or range violation
classes.description: A relation is used with a subject or object outside its intended domain or range.

classes.label: Cardinality breach
classes.description: A graph violates an explicit cardinality or required-value constraint.

classes.label: Temporal impossibility
classes.description: A graph violates a temporal ordering constraint.

classes.label: Grounding error
classes.description: A triple is not supported by the source sentence.

notes: OWL functional-property conflicts require explicit distinctness or distinct literal values to produce an inconsistency.
Missing minimum-cardinality values are not OWL inconsistencies under the open-world assumption.
Changes following the pilot annotation will be recorded as a new version.
